analysis.scoreReason: RSI 중립 구간 횡보, MACD 개선 미흡
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI neutral range consolidation, MACD improvement lacking
analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. 금일 RSI 50.7로 중립 구간 안착, MACD 히스토그램 945.2521로 개선세 지속. 그러나 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.67로 위축된 거래량은 상승 동력 부족 시사. 35,895원 현재가 기준 스윙 저항 36,570원, 스윙 지지 34,485원 구간 내 횡보 지속.
analysis.reasonEn: The previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see approach. Today, RSI at 50.7 has settled in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram at 945.2521 continues to show improvement. However, the volume ratio of 0.67 compared to the 5-day average suggests a lack of upward momentum. The current price of 35,895 KRW is trading within the range between the swing resistance of 36,570 KRW and swing support of 34,485 KRW, indicating continued consolidation.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly chart shows weakness, but daily signals take precedence

· MACD histogram trajectory (552.5306→945.2521) + Improving, bottoming signal

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + Consider buying on breakout above 36,570 KRW, selling on break below 34,485 KRW
